title: Personal Loans Rate Cut on a PracticePay Patient Financing Payment Reset
content:
**Rule.** The personal-loan rate cut of a PracticePay Patient Financing payment reset reads every Larkspur personal loan the customer has held: when the customer holds an active personal loan and no late fee and no returned payment were posted on any of the customer's personal loans within the last 12 months, the cut is 2.00 percentage points; when the customer holds an active personal loan and a returned payment but no late fee was posted on any of them within the last 12 months, the cut is 1.00 percentage point; in every other case the cut is 0; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the reset date, a month being whole once the reset date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Active loan under Personal Loans | Personal-loan late fee, 12 months | Personal-loan returned payment, 12 months | Rate cut (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | none | none | 2.00 |
| yes | none | one or more | 1.00 |
| yes | one or more | any | 0 |
| no | any | any | 0 |

*Hypothetical.* A plan APR of 15.00 with this cut at 2.00, and no other cut, gives a reset rate of 13.00.
